verdict.rationale: Claude Code's core interface is natural-language: docs describe users stating intent in plain language and Claude planning, coding, testing, and handling git/PR workflows autonomously (docs-2, docs-1, docs-3, docs-16). Community feedback confirms this is a functioning agentic NL interface, though some users report reliability/quality degradation in execution over time (comm-16, comm-17, comm-19), which affects trust but not the fundamental NL-command capability.
